newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Central Europe's CESI hits second successive high.
newsitem.headline: Central Europe's CESI hits second successive high.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index rose on Friday to a new high, the second in a row, of 1,539.29 points, up 19.85 points or 1.31 percent, the Budapest Stock Stock Exchange said on its Reuters page.
The index soared as all the three markets closed higher.
The index, which has been published since February 1, reflects trends of 50 shares on the Budapest, Prague and Warsaw bourses. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 266 2410
